description: This file defines the ContextDAO interface in the OpenMRS project, specifying database access functions related to user authentication, session management, cache control, and search index updates.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user with provided username and password, returning the user if successful or throwing an exception if authentication fails.

methods.name: getUserByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a User object from the database based on its UUID.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a User object from the database based on username.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified roles and password.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Opens a database session.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes the current database session.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears the current session cache.

methods.name: flushSession
methods.description: Flushes changes in the current session to the database.

methods.name: evictFromSession
methods.description: Removes a specific object from the session cache.

methods.name: evictEntity
methods.description: Evicts an entity object from the cache.

methods.name: evictAllEntities
methods.description: Evicts all instances of a given entity class from the cache.

methods.name: clearEntireCache
methods.description: Clears all cache regions.

methods.name: refreshEntity
methods.description: Refreshes the state of an object from the database.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Initializes the system with provided properties.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the system gracefully.

methods.name: mergeDefaultRuntimeProperties
methods.description: Merges default database connection properties with runtime properties.

methods.name: setupSearchIndex
methods.description: Updates the search index if needed based on version mismatch.

methods.name: updateSearchIndex
methods.description: Triggers an update of the search index.

methods.name: updateSearchIndexAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous update of the search index.

methods.name: updateSearchIndexForObject
methods.description: Updates the search index for a specific object.

methods.name: updateSearchIndexForType
methods.description: Updates the search index for a specific class type.

methods.name: updateSearchIndex
methods.description: Updates the search index for multiple types.

methods.name: getDatabaseConnection
methods.description: Provides a database connection from the connection pool.
